description: Repository-global, tracked change-proposal record. A proposal freezes the source, target, and merge-base commits reviewed by a human; its lifecycle is changed only through the change-proposal API. Lix change history records when lifecycle writes occur and their provenance.

source_branch_id.description: Branch that authored the proposed change.

target_branch_id.description: Branch the proposal is intended to merge into.

base_commit_id.description: Merge base pinned when the proposal was opened.

source_head_commit_id.description: Source head pinned when the proposal was opened.

target_head_commit_id.description: Target head pinned when the proposal was opened.

state.description: Lifecycle state. The proposal API is the only mutation surface.

accepted_target_head_commit_id.description: Target head produced by acceptance; null for open or rejected proposals.
